<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the forward amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine → amide). This will break a carboxylic acid functional group and form an amide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C(=O)N",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
